newsitem.title: UK: IPE June gas oil closes $1.50 up on late buying.
newsitem.headline: IPE June gas oil closes $1.50 up on late buying.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed on the upside on Monday on the back of some pre-close buying, traders said.
June gas oil closed $1.50 up at $174 a tonne and July gas oil closed at $175.25 a tonne, also $1.50 higher than Friday's close.
"There was more buyers than sellers. Some good quality buying came in from some players," one broker said.
"With (NYMEX) heating oil holding, the shorts are going to start buying back," the broker added.

Meanwhile, IPE July Brent continued to rise into higher territory in the late afternoon on the back of a stronger-than expected July WTI, trading at $19.59 a barrel, or 19 cents higher by 1638 GMT, after hitting a high of $19.62 a little while earlier.
This was one point off the next resistance level for the July Brent contract, traders said. --Haitham Haddadin, London newsroom +44 171 542 8145
